alex: quick flag - seeing TTFT spike for /v1/chat/stream ~80ms increase last hour. suspect kernel-selector roll to fallback microkernel on long seqs :thinking:
mina: where are you seeing that? dashboard or logs?
alex: dashboard — token_breakdown route=/v1/chat/stream granularity=1m
alex: logs show repeated `choose_kernel(v2->micro)` and KV cache miss bursts:

```
[2026-03-17T10:12:01Z] kernel_selector: choose_kernel route=/v1/chat/stream seq_len=1024 reason=kv_cache_miss
[2026-03-17T10:12:01Z] kvcache: miss_count=18 prefetch=false
```

ryan: hmm, microkernel has ~40ms higher per-token decode in our infra. could be batching heuristics creating smaller batches -> inefficiency
sasha: can you dump batch sizes for that time window? `select batch_size, count(*) from token_events where route='/v1/chat/stream' and ts > ...`
alex: grabbing samples, posting shortly
obs-bot: metric alert: TTFT > 200ms for route=/v1/chat/stream (3m avg)
mina: quick hypothesis: KV-prefetch disabled on that host causing selector to downgrade. We recently rolled a scheduler tweak that tightens batch cutoff at 16 tokens.
ryan: if batch cutoff lowered, we can get more small batches -> kernel fallback triggers more often because microkernel path likes tight microbatching? Not sure.
alex: sample dump: `batch_size histogram: {1: 120, 2: 340, 4: 480, 8: 210, 16: 60}` during spike vs baseline `{1:30,2:90,4:200,8:400,16:300}`
sasha: that looks like drift toward smaller batches
alex: propose dashboard panel: stacked bar of batch_size distribution + kernel chosen + kv_hit_rate by minute. quick grafana query draft:

```
sum by(minute, kernel, batch_size) (count_over_time(token_events{route='/v1/chat/stream'}[1m]))
kv_hit_rate = sum(kv_hits)/sum(kv_requests)
```

mina: also add a panel for `kernel_switch_reason` tag distribution
ryan: quick experiment: revert batch cutoff tweak on a single zone and run canary for 30m. If TTFT falls, we pin fix and then improve selector logic to consider recent kv_hit_rate when selecting kernel.
alex: agreed. I'll spin canary. tagging infra: @sre @eng-runtime
sasha: also add sampling hook to attach kernel and kv_hit tags to the token tracer so we can correlate per-token latency end-to-end
alex: thanks. I'll post results here. :thumbsup:
